Feasibility of glycated haemoglobin target-setting in adults with diabetes: A mixed-methods study. HbA1c targets guide diabetes management to reduce complications, yet their psychological effects are poorly understood. This feasibility study evaluated the practicality of conducting a definitive trial evaluating the impact of explicit HbA1c target-setting in adults with diabetes. Evaluation of Four Semi-Mechanistic Models for Predicting Glycemic Control With a Glucagon Receptor Antagonist in People With Type 2 Diabetes. Glycated hemoglobin (HbA1c) is the gold standard for measuring long-term glycemic efficacy over at least 3 months in Type 2 diabetes (T2D). Being able to predict HbA1c using glucose response from studies of less than 3 months would be useful.
